t51a84364: Time and attendance software with working-time records · Turnera
t72491572: Turnera’s Human Resources module, for any team with people who clock in and shifts to arrange: care homes, residents’ associations, workshops, shops, clinics or academies. It handles clocking in, the rota, the work calendar and the working-time record, with no diary, no clients and nothing you don’t need.
tf11b6ab2: Turnera is built in parts, and each part is called a module: the appointment book, customer records, the till, invoicing, staff. A module is a part of the application that is switched on or off depending on what your centre needs.
t7f0775e7: Human Resources is the module that looks after your employees, and it can be taken on its own: you see only what you use and pay only for that. If you ever need another part, it is switched on without changing application.
t3df81cad: Everyone clocks in, out or on a break with their PIN, at the clock by the door or from the native mobile app, checks their own entries for the month and receives them by email or as a PDF.
tb711368d: Who works each day and on which shift, who is off or on holiday and who is in right now. On the home screen you see who should have clocked in and hasn’t.
ta3290f13: Each year’s agreement with its hours and holiday days, the shifts, the types of absence and the public holidays. National and regional holidays load themselves when you choose the centre’s region.
tc03f58ac: Hours clocked outside the shift are recorded as overtime in each professional’s bank, and you decide whether it is paid in the payroll or taken back as time off. If in the year they go past the 80 hours the Spanish Workers’ Statute allows, the screen warns you.
tbb5c42df: Each month is closed for payroll and can be reopened to adjust it, with the reason written down. Each person carries the code your accountant knows them by.
t60318f9a: The full record comes out in Excel, CSV and as a monthly PDF with space for signatures. And you can give the Labour Inspectorate or the workers’ representatives a read-only link that expires and logs every access.
t1673e92a: Screenshots of Turnera HR with demo data: the staff module only. No sketches, no mock-ups.
t6e5567a1: The clock by the door: each person taps their name, types their PIN and clocks in, takes a break or clocks out. Anyone who has no PIN yet is easy to spot, and administration sets it on their record. You can also clock from the native mobile app, with the same PIN and in the same record.
tf86b2ff9: Mornings, afternoons, split shifts, midday shifts and Saturday cover in the same calendar: each day carries its shift, and holidays, sick leave, leave of absence and public holidays are painted apart.
tb68bca56: The agreement minus what is planned says how many hours are still to be scheduled, and what is planned up to today minus what was clocked gives the difference. Beside it, what was actually worked: regular hours, out-of-shift hours and the pool still to be compensated.
tc57d3ff3: Who works each day and on which shift, with the public holidays already in and who is in right now.
t5d54c7ff: By professional and month, planned hours against clocked hours, split into normal and out-of-shift hours, ready to download as CSV.
t6acd3230: You pay for each professional on your team.
t5208ed04: You don’t pay for users or premises. Each band applies only to the professionals who fall in it, so there are no jumps when you move from one to the next.
te1a0cfde: Minimum fee of €10 a month. Prices exclude VAT. Paying the year in advance means ten monthly payments instead of twelve.
tffc4dfb2: Everything included: what you see above and whatever comes next. Technical support by email, no commissions and no lock-in. We set up your centre with you, at no cost.
t99f9f331: Can staff clock in from their phone?
t94c8ee5a: Yes. As well as the clock at the entrance, each person can clock in from the native staff app for Android, with the same PIN and in the same record. When clocking in by phone, the place it was done from is noted, only at that moment, and it never stops anyone from clocking in.
tec139925: How do I show the record to the Labour Inspectorate?
t61f33216: With a read-only link that you create, for whoever you specify and for the number of days you choose, up to 90. Whoever opens it sees the record and can download the same files, and every access is logged. You can withdraw it before it expires, and workers’ representatives see it without tax ID numbers.
te39724d3: Do I have to enter public holidays by hand?
tba4ccc11: No. National holidays and those of your autonomous community load automatically when you choose the centre’s community.
t728e1703: Do I need the diary or the client records?
t1c0ffcb0: No. Human Resources is taken on its own, with no diary, no clients and no till. If one day you need them, they’re switched on in the same application, and we tell you beforehand how much your fee changes.
t633ffb66: €2.50 per professional per month for the first 25, €2.00 from 26 to 100 and €1.50 from 101 on, with a minimum fee of €10 a month. Prices exclude VAT, and if you pay for the year in advance you pay ten monthly instalments instead of twelve.
tb299c8fb: No. No minimum term and no commissions, with technical support by email included. And we set up your centre with you, at no cost.
t5ae2e85c: And if you need more tomorrow
tc63978c4: Because Human Resources is a module and not a separate program, you can add others without changing application or loading anything again: the appointment book and customer records if you work by appointment, the till and invoicing, or maintenance reports with photos for inspections. What you already have stays where it is and the new part appears in the menu. Before switching anything on, we tell you how much your fee changes.
